disambiguation: Not a general-purpose symbolic math solver; it focuses on visualization and interactive graphing within notes.
extras: Includes third-party assets (Material Symbols, Lora) and has several known limitations regarding complex functions and specific block behaviors.
intentEvidence: LMath brings mathematical graphing directly into your Obsidian notes.
motivation: It is designed to keep mathematical exploration and mathematical writing in the same place.
problem: It addresses the need to visualize mathematical functions and concepts without leaving the note-taking environment.
summary: LMath is an Obsidian plugin that allows users to graph mathematical functions, systems, derivatives, integrals, and vectors directly within notes using custom blocks.
